summary: CATASTERI AS (org. no. 915 918 352) is a private limited company (AS) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2015-11-06. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 70.200 (Bedriftsrådgivning og annen administrativ rådgivning); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) net income was NOK 6.7 m. Board chair: Erik Romundset Hauge; auditor: TEAM REVISJON AS.
